ios.desc:
Codeusse: The smartest SSH client

Mobile development has just moved beyond simple terminal emulators. As AI-native workflows like Claude Code, OpenCode, Mistral Vibe, Aider, etc., become central to the modern developer's toolkit, the need for a mobile interface that can handle high-density text, complex command-line feedback, and rapid file manipulation has never been greater.

Codeusse is a professional-grade SSH client built to bring your desktop-class AI workflow to your pocket. Designed to fit seamlessly into the rhythm of modern engineering, it provides a stable, persistent bridge to your remote environments, optimized specifically for the unique demands of keyboard-first, AI-driven development.

Codeusse doesn't just give you a shell; it gives you a workspace. Navigate projects with a high-performance file browser, perform precision edits with a touch-friendly code editor, and accelerate your development with a built-in refactor agent designed to handle routine code transformations on the fly.
Whether you are running a complex Claude Code, OpenCode, Mistral Vibe, or Aider session, manually debugging a production issue, or want to have a convenient way to manage your homelab, Codeusse ensures that your tools work for you, not against you.

At the core of Codeusse is Foam, our signature design language and layout engine. Traditional mobile apps struggle to fit text-heavy IDEs into the constraints of a touch screen, often resulting in cramped windows or exhausting context-switching.
Foam solves this by organizing your workspace into dynamic "bubbles" that respect the physics of mobile input. Instead of rigid panes, your Editor, Terminal, and File Explorer exist in a fluid, elastic environment. With a simple tap, a tool expands into focus while others gracefully collapse into reachable, non-intrusive bars.
Foam is more than just a layout; it is a novel approach to fitting the complexity of a text-heavy desktop environment into the mobile ecosystem, ensuring that your feedback loops remain tight and your focus remains unbroken.

Key Features
Optimized for Claude Code, OpenCode, Mistral Vibe, and Aider: Enhanced terminal handling for high-density AI feedback and long-running interactive sessions.
Pro-Grade SSH & SFTP: Persistent, secure connections to your remote infrastructure with integrated file management.
Touch-First Code Editor: A precision editor designed for mobile, featuring syntax highlighting and ergonomic navigation.
Built-in Refactor Agent: E

show_hn.title: Show HN: Codeusse – mobile SSH with GUI file browser and LLM config gen

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I’m Marcin, a solo dev.

I’m building Codeusse because I believe mobile devices have the potential to be great dev machines, but the software layer is stuck in 2015.

My goal is to enable "doom coding" by replacing scrolling time with coding time via a proper mobile IDE.
Right now it is an SSH client that gives you a workspace rather than a plain terminal.

The problem: Most mobile SSH clients handle touch input poorly. Modifiers are a pain and file editing is risky.

The solution: I added a full GUI file browser over SFTP so you don't have to navigate blindly. I also integrated an LLM into the editor. You can type natural language prompts to generate config files or scripts, which solves the issue of typing complex syntax on a virtual keyboard.

I’m charging a small subscription to cover server costs and development.

HN deal: If you support the project now, your price is locked forever. When I release the full IDE features and hike the price for the public, early HN users will keep the current price permanently.

Link: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/codeusse-ssh-client/id6757916854
Page: https://codeusse.wrbl.xyz
Feedback on the terminal rendering engine is highly appreciated. Android version is coming in the future.
